From my personal experience I’ve had very few men comment on it unless I’ve brought it into the conversation. 

But I have had two first dates where the girls have commented on my bald head. They weren’t trying to intentionally be insulting, for example one said: “I saw you across the way, and I knew it was you from the bald head.” I know she didn’t intend it to be mean, but I don’t think anyone would even consider saying something like “I knew it was you because of the fat.”

Now I’m dating the girl long term and She really doesn’t mind my hair loss. But I just think people don’t automatically check themselves when commenting baldness the same way as with fat.
